1: // Minimal endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   // Helper to draw background gradient and stars
6:   const backgroundStars = [];
7:   function initBackgroundStars(count = 100) {
8:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
9:       backgroundStars.push({
10:         x: Math.random() * w,
11:         y: Math.random() * h,
12:         r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
13:         alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
14:       });
15:     }
16:   }
17:   function drawBackground() {
18:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
19:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
20:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#013');
21:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
22:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
23:     // Draw background stars
24:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
25:     backgroundStars.forEach(s => {
26:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
27:       ctx.beginPath();
28:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
29:       ctx.fill();
30:     });
31:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
32:   }
33:   // Initialize stars once
34:   initBackgroundStars();
35: 
36:   // Helper to draw the ship as a triangle
37:   function drawShip() {
38:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
39:     ctx.beginPath();
40:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
41:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
42:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
43:     ctx.closePath();
44:     ctx.fill();
45:   }
46: 
47:   // Helper to draw obstacles with optional rotation
48:   function drawObstacle(o) {
49:     ctx.save();
50:     ctx.translate(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2);
51:     ctx.rotate(o.angle || 0);
52:     ctx.translate(-o.w / 2, -o.h / 2);
53:     ctx.fillStyle = o.type === 'laser' ? '#f44' : '#f90';
54:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, o.w, o.h);
55:     ctx.restore();
56:   }
57: 
58:   // Helper to draw stars as glowing circles
59:   function drawStar(s) {
60:     const radius = s.size / 2;
61:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x + radius, s.y + radius, 0, s.x + radius, s.y + radius, radius);
62:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
63:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#550');
64:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
65:     ctx.beginPath();
66:     ctx.arc(s.x + radius, s.y + radius, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
67:     ctx.fill();
68:   }
69: 
70:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
71:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
72:   const w = canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
73:   const h = canvas.height = canvas.height || 400;
74: 
75:   // Audio setup
76:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
77:   function resumeAudio() { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); }
78:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
79:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
80:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
81:     osc.type = 'sine';
82:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
83:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
84:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
85:     osc.start();
86:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
87:   }
88: 
89:   // Game constants
90:   const GRAVITY = 0.4;
91:   const THRUST = -8;
92:   const SHIP_W = 40;
93:   const SHIP_H = 20;
94:   const OBSTACLE_W = 30;
95:   const STAR_SIZE = 15;
96:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
97:   const STAR_INTERVAL = 3000; // ms
98: 
99:   // State
100:   let ship = { x: 80, y: h / 2, vy: 0, w: SHIP_W, h: SHIP_H };
101:   let obstacles = [];
102:   let stars = [];
103:   let score = 0;
104:   let lastObs = 0;
105:   let lastStar = 0;
106:   let running = true;
107: 
108:   // Input – thrust on click/touch
109:   const thrust = () => { resumeAudio(); playTone(440, 0.1); ship.vy = THRUST; };
110:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', thrust);
111:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); thrust(); }, { passive: false });
112: 
113:   // Helper: random int in [min, max)
114:   const randInt = (min, max) => Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min)) + min;
115: 
116:   function spawnObstacle() {
117:     // Randomly choose type: asteroid (square) or laser (thin vertical)
118:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'asteroid' : 'laser';
119:     const y = randInt(0, h - OBSTACLE_W);
120:     const wObs = type === 'laser' ? 5 : OBSTACLE_W;
121:     const hObs = type === 'laser' ? OBSTACLE_W * 3 : OBSTACLE_W;
122:     const angle = type === 'asteroid' ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5 : 0;
123:     obstacles.push({ x: w, y, w: wObs, h: hObs, type, angle });
124:   }
125: 
126:   function spawnStar() {
127:     const y = randInt(0, h - STAR_SIZE);
128:     stars.push({ x: w, y, size: STAR_SIZE, collected: false });
129:   }
130: 
131:   // Sound helpers
132:   function playStarSound() { playTone(660, 0.05); }
133:   function playCollisionSound() { playTone(220, 0.2); }
134: 
135: 
136:   function rectCollide(a, b) {
137:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
138:   }
139: 
140:   function update(dt) {
141:     // Ship physics
142:     ship.vy += GRAVITY;
143:     ship.y += ship.vy;
144:     if (ship.y + ship.h > h) { ship.y = h - ship.h; running = false; }
145:     if (ship.y < 0) { ship.y = 0; ship.vy = 0; }
146: 
147:     // Move obstacles & stars
148:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= 4);
149:     stars.forEach(s => s.x -= 4);
150: 
151:     // Remove off‑screen
152:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
153:     stars = stars.filter(s => s.x + s.size > 0 && !s.collected);
154: 
155:     // Collision detection
156:     for (const o of obstacles) {
157:       if (rectCollide(ship, o)) { playCollisionSound(); running = false; break; }
158:     }
159:     for (const s of stars) {
160:       if (!s.collected && rectCollide(ship, { x: s.x, y: s.y, w: s.size, h: s.size })) {
161:         s.collected = true;
162:         score += 10;
163:       }
164:     }
165: 
166:     // Scoring over time
167:     score += dt * 0.01;
168:   }
169: 
170:   function draw() {
171:     // Clear and draw background gradient
172:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
173:     drawBackground();
174:     // Ship
175:     drawShip();
176:     // Obstacles
177:     obstacles.forEach(drawObstacle);
178:     // Stars
179:     stars.forEach(s => { if (!s.collected) drawStar(s); });
180:     // Score
181:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
182:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
183:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
184:     if (!running) {
185:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
186:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
187:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
188:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
189:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', w / 2, h / 2);
190:     }
191:   }
192: 
193:   let lastTime = 0;
194:   function loop(timestamp) {
195:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
196:     lastTime = timestamp;
197:     if (running) {
198:       // Spawn logic
199:       if (timestamp - lastObs > SPAWN_INTERVAL) { spawnObstacle(); lastObs = timestamp; }
200:       if (timestamp - lastStar > STAR_INTERVAL) { spawnStar(); lastStar = timestamp; }
201:       update(dt);
202:     }
203:     draw();
204:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
205:   }
206: 
207:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
208: })();
